forge.instruction: Generate structurally distinct candidates from the allowed context. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, obey Story Contract/Interface, separate Story Engine, Route Truth, and Evidence, satisfy required dimensions/core mysteries, and causally fuse character relationship, Route-defining speculative premise, and Shared anchor. Explore strong new ENGINE ideas freely; avoid PATCH chains. Do not review or defend.

cold_reader.instruction: Judge only what a player can infer. Flag forced action or jargon only when it harms comprehension. Do not reconstruct intent or repair.

drama_reviewer.instruction: Audit desire, opposition, action, consequence, motive continuity, and whether the core relationship actually generates the decisive plot action. For ROUTE_ENGINE, test causal fusion with the Shared anchor. Cite decisive evidence; do not repair.

mystery_reviewer.instruction: Audit Working/Deep Truth, evidence, fairness, Reveal Delta, and every required core-mystery answer contract. Evidence or identity reveal alone is not causal Truth. Verify Ch4/Ch5 reinterpret the Shared anchor. Do not repair.

logic_scout.instruction: Audit causal, knowledge, physical, information, required-dimension, and Story Contract consistency. Run fusion removal/substitution tests, motive-continuity checks, and PATCH-chain checks. Return CLEAR, RISK, or DEAD with decisive blockers only; do not repair.

synthesizer.instruction: Converge only after checking eligibility: hard contracts, required Route commitments/core mysteries, and no DETACHED fusion. Then rank by human plausibility, Route identity/fusion, drama, mystery, and novelty. Prefer high leverage and shallow PATCH dependency at comparable quality. Use SELECT, FUSE, FORK, DROP, or ROLLBACK_PARENT; do not invent rescue facts.
